products.title: Baarbara Estate - Whiskey Barrel Aged
products.body_html:
This coffee’s journey began at Baarbara Estate in the foothills of Baba Budangiri, the origin of coffee in India. It was shaped by a process the estate has spent years refining, with one precise outcome in mind: a cup where whiskey’s character and coffee’s identity sit in balance. 

The barrels this coffee was aged in were brought in within 15 days of malt being removed. They were then housed in a covered, controlled space, away from direct sunlight and changing weather. The coffee beans were allowed to rest in them for nearly four months, with the barrels carefully turned every few days, and the beans cupped regularly as the flavours evolved. Over time, the coffee gently absorbed the oak’s character while holding on to its own. 

The result is a medium roast with notes of red plum, whiskey oak, ripe banana, and cocoa. Expect wine-like aromas with a hint of gentle, sweet cardamom and a lingering Irish cream finish in a cup that’s layered and complex. 

Our roasters recommend brewing it black, either as an espresso, cold brew, pour over or using an AeroPress. 

Note: The whiskey tasting notes in this coffee are a result of its unique processing. The offering in this pack is non-alcoholic.

Recommended Resting Period: 10 days

products.title: Riverdale Estate - Mosto
products.body_html:
Prakashan has always treated coffee as something to keep learning from. His curious, experimentative lens has introduced us to many remarkable coffees over the years. Exploring how one fermentation can influence another, this special lot is no different.  

As coffee cherries ferment, they release a microbe-rich liquid called Mosto. Prakashan and his team collected it from a Gesha they had processed earlier. For this lot, he then used it as a starter culture, guiding SLN 9 cherries through a 72-hour fermentation. Slow drying on raised beds for 25-30 days locked the developments that had set in. The result is a coffee with remarkable complexity and character.  

It brews cups that bring a delicate balance of bright, fruity layers and florality, on the nose and in the sip. A silky mouthfeel unwraps notes of pink pomelo, tart cherries, chamomile, and pomegranate. Adding further depth and delight is the gooseberry-like finish.  

Recommended Resting Period:  13 days

Note: This coffee pack is a special release with limited availability and, therefore, cannot be included in a subscription plan.

products.title: Raxidi Lobo Estate - Pichia Yeast
products.body_html:
Over the last few harvests, producers Richard Jos and Rachel Lobo have focused on the anaerobic natural process. Building on lessons they've learnt, they chose the Pichia yeast for this lot.  

Its journey began with 15 seasoned pickers from the estate's permanent staff harvesting ripe red cherries. After washing with fresh spring water and filtering out low-density floaters, the best of the harvest was moved to stainless steel tanks. There, Pichia yeast guided a 48-hour anaerobic fermentation, followed by slow drying on raised beds for 21 days.  

Roasted to a light profile, the result is an expressive lot that opens with the aroma of strawberry jam, trailed by layers that move from raspberry and plum tart to marigold and red cherry. The pleasant, punchy finish that rounds off each sip reminds us of candied orange peels.  

We recommend brewing this coffee black, either as a pour over or using an AeroPress.

Recommended Resting Period:  13 days

Note: This coffee pack is a special release with limited availability and, therefore, cannot be included in a subscription plan.

products.title: The Monsoon Trio
products.body_html:
This Pack includes:

  1. Monsoon Malabar AA- Hoysala Estate - 75g
  2. St. Joseph Estate - 75g
  3. Sampigehoney Estate - 75g 

This selection brings together three comforting medium-dark roasts that feel especially at home during the monsoon. From a coffee shaped by the season itself to one grown by a community of Jesuit priests. 
 
Monsoon Malabar AA - Hoysala Estate 
Low in acidity and full in body, this coffee is delightfully nutty and smooth. Brew it in a French Press, Moka Pot, or as an espresso, milky or black, it’s equally rewarding. 
Tasting Notes: Cocoa Nibs, Nutty, Raisins. 
 
St. Joseph Estate 
A washed coffee with gentle spice aromatics and a medium-high body that adds depth to every cup. Roasted medium-dark, it finishes with a mellow, chocolatey sweetness. 
Tasting Notes: Grapefruit, Clove, Toffee. 
 
Sampigehoney Estate 
Opening with aromas of honey and raisins, this coffee brews a syrupy cup with notes of orange marmalade, dark chocolate and raisins. Its lingering chocolatey finish makes it a lovely companion to watch the rain.
Tasting Notes: Orange Marmalade, Dark Chocolate, Raisins.

products.title: Sampigehoney Estate
products.body_html:
A regular on our seasonal roster returns. This medium-dark roast, processed using the washed method, brews comforting cups with a chocolatey and nutty flavour profile.

It opens with aromas of honey and raisins, leading to a syrupy mouthfeel and medium-high body. Each sip offers layers of zesty orange marmalade, rich dark chocolate, and sweet raisins, rounded off by a lingering chocolatey finish.

Delicious both black and with milk, this coffee is best brewed as an espresso, in a French Press, or with a Moka Pot.

Recommended Resting Period: 9 Days

products.title: Unakki Estate
products.body_html:
Nestled in the picturesque Joldal Palya of Chikmagalur, Unakki estate stretches across nearly 100 acres of lush green forests. This season, the estate presents a balanced medium roast, crafted to capture the essence of its unique terroir and provide a rich, satisfying coffee experience.

It opens with a sweet, honey-like aroma taking you to the delicious notes of chocolate, brown spices and raisins. With a syrupy mouthfeel and a tea-like finish, expect medium bitterness and acidity in your brew.

The perfect companion to moments of quiet, or pleasantly slow mornings, our roasters recommend brewing it black, either as an espresso, pour over, or using a Moka Pot or an AeroPress.

Recommended Resting Period: 10 days

products.title: M.S. Estate
products.body_html:
We’re excited to bring you the latest harvest from MS Estate, a cherished part of our perennial selection. This washed coffee features S795 and a rare Ethiopian varietal, with MS Estate being the only Indian farm still cultivating the latter since it was first distributed by the Coffee Board in the late 1990s. 

When you first taste this medium roast, you’ll notice its unique depth and complexity. The aroma of dried fruits, with hints of apricots and peaches, sets the stage for each sip. As you continue, savour the combination of a chocolatey essence along with a distinct tea-like finish that lingers on the palate. 

A versatile coffee, it tastes great black as well as with milk. We recommend brewing it as an espresso, a pourover, or using an AeroPress or a Moka Pot.

Recommended Resting Period: 8 Days

products.title: Krishnagiri Estate
products.body_html:
A single origin dark roast, this coffee comes from a Rainforest Alliance-certified farm. The producers used a custom-designed pulper to process this washed lot, minimising water usage.  

In the cup, you'll first notice the aroma of brown spices. The brew, characterised by mellow acidity, a heavy body, and a velvety mouthfeel, reminds of oak, toasted walnuts, and malt. A bittersweet finish lingers between sips.  

We recommend brewing this coffee as an espresso, using a Moka Pot, French Press, or an AeroPress. It is rich enough to enjoy black, and also pairs well with milk.

Recommended Resting Period: 7 Days

products.title: Salawara Estate
products.body_html:
Our newest release comes from the mist-threaded hills of Chikmagalur. Crafted by third-generation producer, Sharan, this anaerobic natural lot brews punchy cups with pleasant sweetness.  

Roasted to a light profile, this coffee feels like a burst of fruit from the first whiff to the last sip. It opens with pineapple and molasses on the nose, before settling into red apple, pear, and almond on the palate. Each sip comes with a well-rounded mouthfeel, a medium body, and a zesty finish. 

Our roasters recommend brewing it black, either as a pour over or using an AeroPress.

Recommended Resting Period: 12 days

products.title: Kerehaklu Estate - Blossom Culture
products.body_html:
With the estate shrouded in fog on a January morning, Pranoy noticed unseasonal blossoms in one of the blocks. There, he had the idea of collecting jarfuls of these blossoms for a starter culture. The goal was to see what happens when Kerehaklu's own microbiome shapes processing. 
 
Aiding a 71-hour anoxic fermentation, the blossom culture interacted with naturally processed cherries to build fruity layers and a distinctive jamminess. To preserve this development, the coffee was dried on raised beds for three weeks. 
 
Roasted to a light profile, the result is a unique expression of provenance. The cup opens with the aroma of ripe berries, followed by notes of strawberry, orange blossom, pomegranate, and sun melon. A delicate floral finish rounds off each sip.

Recommended Resting Period: 12 days

Note: This coffee pack is a special release with limited availability and, therefore, cannot be included in a subscription plan.

products.title: Attikan Estate
products.body_html:
Attikan Estate’s arabica coffee beans come from the Biligiriranga Hills in Karnataka and make for one of our most popular coffees. Sweet with nutty overtones and balanced acidity, this is the darkest of our standard medium roasts and recommended for espresso lovers. It is a versatile coffee that also works for manual brewing methods such as Moka Pot, South Indian Filter and AeroPress. 

Located to the south of Mysore, the Biligiriranga Hills, or ‘white hills’ are named after the mist that hangs over the region. At 1650 meters, it is amongst the highest coffee growing regions in India and grows Selection 9, Selection 795, Cauvery and Kent varieties of Arabica, along with Silver Oaks, citrus, and fig trees.

Recommended Resting Period: 10 Days

products.title: 13th Birthday Blend
products.body_html:
This celebratory blend brings together natural lots from Stanmore, Orchardale, and Riverdale Estates in Yercaud, along with a washed lot from Unakki Estate in Chikmagalur, which forms the base. Its flavour profile takes us back to the Black Forest cakes many of us celebrated birthdays with during our teen years. 

Opening with the aroma of honey and strawberries, the cup has a medium-high body and a round mouthfeel. You'll notice notes of strawberry, chocolate, cherry, and pear, followed by a lingering finish of chocolate-covered strawberries. 

This blend brews well across a range of methods, including espresso, AeroPress, French Press, Moka Pot, and Pour Over. Equally enjoyable black or with milk, it lends itself to a wide range of recipes.

Recommended Resting Period: 10 Day

products.title: Howdia Estate
products.body_html:
One of our roasters' favourites, Howdia Estate returns for Harvest '26. It reminds us of a floral black tea, and is among the most delicate light roasts on our roster. Processed using the washed method, it brews cups with low bitterness, bright acidity, and a well-rounded mouthfeel. From the first whiff, it's florality comes through, giving way to a bright, tea-like sip with notes of coffee blossoms and orange marmalade, and a black tea-like finish. For a clean, nuanced cup, we recommend brewing this coffee black as a pour over or using an AeroPress.

Recommended Resting Period: 10 days

Note: This coffee pack has limited availability and therefore cannot be included in a subscription plan.

products.title: St. Joseph Estate
products.body_html:
Meet the first coffee from our newest partner farm, run by a community of Jesuit priests whose stewardship of the land spans generations. 

A washed coffee roasted medium-dark, it opens with warm brown spice aromatics. Each sip carries a syrupy mouthfeel and reminds of grapefruit, roasted almond, and toffee. Its medium-high body gives the cup a comforting depth, complemented by a chocolatey aftertaste. 

Our roasters recommend brewing it as an espresso, or using an AeroPress, Moka Pot, or French Press. A versatile brew, it pairs well with milk, and holds its own black.

Recommended Resting Period: 11 Days

products.title: Raxidi Lobo Estate - Anaerobic Natural
products.body_html:
We've been excited to collaborate with Raxidi Lobo Estate since their debut with us last year. So, when we first tasted a sample of this anaerobic natural lot, we knew it had to be a part of Harvest '26.  

To bring it to life, the producers started fermenting some of the season's best cherries. Introducing a specially curated yeast strain to the mix, they let the process go on for 48 hours. Finally, slow drying on raised beds for 21 days locked flavour.  

Roasted to a medium profile, the result is a cup that carries the sweet nostalgia of drinking mosambi juice in summer. It opens with berries and cherry on the nose, then settles into tart-sweet, bright notes of mosambi, green apple, and plum. The mouthfeel is velvety with a medium body, and the finish is long and tea-like.  

Our roasters recommend brewing it black, either as a pour over, or using an AeroPress.

Recommended Resting Period: 11 Days

Note: This coffee pack has limited availability and therefore cannot be included in a subscription plan.

products.title: Kerehaklu Estate
products.body_html:
Harvest '26 debuts with a bright, citrusy light roast. A Kerehaklu special, it shows Pranoy and Ajoy's sure hand with washed processing. 

Ripe red Selection 9 cherries collected by seasoned pickers marked the lot's foundation. The producers then used a starter made from the farm's local microbes to aid fermentation. Monitoring temperature and pH regularly, they finished within 37 hours. Next, the coffee was mechanically washed and dried in the shade for three days. Finally, 12 days of polyhouse drying on raised beds locked its flavour. This controlled, aerobic washed process built complexity while harnessing the bean's inherent character.  

Roasted to a light profile, the coffee delivers clean cups that open with the aroma of orange blossoms and brown sugar. Notes of orange, black tea, and green grapes follow, wrapped in a juicy mouthfeel. Expect low bitterness, medium-high acidity, and a lingering finish of orange marmalade.  

Our roasters recommend brewing it black, either as a pour over, or using an AeroPress.

Recommended Resting Period: 12 Days

Note: This coffee pack is a special release with limited availability and, therefore, cannot be included in a subscription plan.

products.title: Sandalwood Estate
products.body_html:
A beloved part of our perennial selection, Sandalwood Estate brews cups with tasting notes of rich dark chocolate, sweet prune and zesty orange marmalade. This washed coffee, with coffee beans of the Sarchimor variety, was grown at a lush coffee estate in Coorg. If you’ve tried our coffees from Attikan and Baarbara Estates, you’ll love the chocolatey flavour profile of this medium-dark roast.  

This heavy bodied coffee has a smooth, syrupy mouthfeel which can best be enjoyed when brewed as an espresso or using a Moka Pot or French Press. The long, sweet aftertaste of butter biscuits and dried fruit comes through beautifully when you allow the brew to cool down a little. 

Recommended Resting Period: 11 Days

products.title: Dhak Blend
products.body_html:
Our Dhak Blend is an ode to one of our favourite Indian trees with its colorful flame-like flowers that signal the onset of Spring. The coffees used in this blend are naturally processed which means that the coffee beans are dried with the cherry, resulting in complex, fruity and sweet flavours.

Roasted dark to bring out flavours of dark chocolate and fruit jam, this blend's heavy cocoa body leaves a smooth lingering aftertaste.

Our roasting team recommends the Dhak Blend for espresso-based drinks as well as manual brews such as the Moka Pot and the French Press.

Recommended Resting Period: 9 Days

products.title: Silver Oak Café Blend
products.body_html:
If our baristas have brewed you an espresso-based drink at any of our coffee shops, you’ll be familiar with this special offering since it’s our signature house blend!  

A small way of bringing our cafe experience to you, this blend features a combination of ground coffee beans, processed using either the washed or the unwashed method. This versatile medium roast is named after the Silver Oak trees commonly found across coffee plantations in Southern India. It works well in espresso-based drinks as well as in manual brews such as AeroPress, pour over or in cold brews. 

Recommended Resting Period: 8 Days

products.title: Amaltas Blend
products.body_html:
An ode to the vibrant burst of yellow that marks the beginning of Indian summers, this blend is our go-to choice for crafting a refreshing batch of coffee including cold brews. In fact, this was originally called the Cold Brew Blend Light but owing to its diversity (its flavours shine through in a Pour Over or Aeropress), we decided to rename it after one of our favourite neighbourhood trees. 

A blend of washed and natural processed coffees, we’ve roasted it light to accentuate fruity and refreshing citrus notes. The result? Balanced cups with notes of blueberry and milk chocolate, with each sip concluding with a chocolatey finish.  

This light and fruity favourite is best enjoyed black.

Recommended Resting Period: 16 Days

products.title: Cold Brew Blend Bold
products.body_html:
Roasted to a medium-dark profile, this blend is perfect for brewing refreshing, full-bodied glasses of cold brew. Expect low acidity, notes of dark chocolate, toffee, and roasted nuts, and a bittersweet finish.

Recommended Resting Period: 11 Days

products.title: Baarbara Estate
products.body_html:
Coffee beans from Baarbara Estate, roasted to a medium-dark profile, have a wonderful aroma of sweet caramel and dried apricot. We love this coffee’s intense, chocolatey flavour profile. To taste the syrupy, smooth mouthfeel of this coffee, we recommend brewing it as a pour over, an espresso or using an AeroPress, Moka Pot or a French Press. If you’ve enjoyed our coffees from Attikan Estate and Sandalwood Estate, you’ll appreciate the sweet aftertaste and medium acidity of this heavy-bodied coffee.

Recommended Resting Period: 8 Days

products.title: Monsoon Malabar AA- Hoysala Estate
products.body_html:
We’re excited to bring back Monsoon Malabar from Hoysala Estate. The unique flavour profile of this coffee develops when winds and humidity from seasonal monsoon rain change the characteristics of the coffee beans. While this process has its accidental roots in colonial India when a shipment to Europe was attacked by the full force of monsoon winds, similar conditions have been recreated in a controlled environment for consistency in every lot produced. 

When roasted medium-dark, the result is a medium-bodied cup that invites with sweet aromas of butter biscuits, treating you to notes of cocoa nibs and dried fruit, concluding with the aftertaste of dark chocolate. Best enjoyed when brewed as an espresso, in the Moka Pot or the French press, the nutty flavour profile of this coffee makes for a delicious cup, either with milk or black. 

Recommended Resting Period: 15 Days

products.title: French Roast
products.body_html:
Our darkest roasted coffee, the French Roast is a blend best enjoyed black for those who like their coffee bold, like a traditional espresso with bittersweet notes. If you’re looking to add milk and still retain a definite bite, this is a great choice. 

We recommend brewing this as an Espresso or using manual brewing equipment such as French Press or Moka Pot.

Recommended Resting Period: 5 Days

products.title: Kalledevarapura Estate - Pulp Sun Dried
products.body_html:
Our all-time favourite pulp sun-dried coffee from Kalledevarapura Estate is back! This year’s harvest boasts a medium body and a sweet mouthfeel, perfect for brewing as an espresso, a pour over, with a Moka Pot or an AeroPress. Each cup reveals rich notes of brown sugar, roasted almond, and raisin.

Recommended Resting Period: 11 Days

products.title: Vienna Roast
products.body_html:
The second darkest of our roasts, this blend, with coffee beans from Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, has great body, low acidity, and is a favourite choice for coffee drinkers who enjoy a strong cup, with its characteristic bittersweet notes. The Vienna Roast is best enjoyed with milk. 

Best enjoyed with milk, we recommend brewing this as an espresso or using manual brewing equipment such as Moka Pot, French Press, or South Indian filter. 

Recommended Resting Period: 9 Days

products.title: Basankhan Estate
products.body_html:
Basankhan Estate was our first ever single origin dark roast. Now a beloved part of our perennial selection, it comes from a family-owned farm with a rich history spanning over 100 years. At the estate, coffee grows alongside black pepper, oranges, cardamom, lemons, and bananas.   

As you take a sip, enjoy the velvety mouthfeel reminiscent of dark chocolate, which enhances the overall richness of this brew. The coffee’s body is heavy and round, creating a luscious and full-bodied experience that envelops your palate. If you’ve liked our dark roasts like Vienna and Dhak, you’ll enjoy this one too!

Recommended Resting Period: 7 Days

products.title: Elkhill Estates
products.body_html:
Our debut coffee from Elkhill, a group of estates spanning 1500 acres, this anaerobic washed lot comes from their first year of specialty cultivation. It brews balanced cups with layers of fruit and spice, and a subtle hint of nuts.

Ripe cherries, harvested at elevations between 457 to 1067 MASL, were fermented for 36 hours. Next, they were washed then slow-dried on raised beds for nearly 18 days to preserve their character.   

Roasted to a medium profile, the result is a cup that opens with the aroma of brown sugar and roasted almonds. Each sip is reminiscent of orange, brown spice, and roasted hazelnut, and ends in a lingering, orange zest-like finish.

Our roasters recommend brewing this coffee as an espresso, a cold brew, or using a Moka Pot. It tastes great black and also works well with milk.

Recommended Resting Period: 11 Days

products.title: Araku - Viishalakshi FPC
products.body_html:
Every harvest brings the excitement of new partnerships and new coffees. This season, we’re proud to introduce our debut lot from Viishalakshi Farmer Producer Company (FPC) in Araku Valley. Named after the valley’s wide-eyed goddess, the FPC brings together 33 
tribal villages around Kusumaguda. This lot comes from seven of those villages, where coffee cultivation is led by women and processed at a communal facility. 

Rooted in natural farming practices for generations, the farmers use composted fruit and vegetable waste to nourish the soil and neem oil treatments to safeguard against pests. Formed last year, Vishalakshi has helped guide these villages from commercial coffee cultivation towards specialty practices. There is now a growing focus on pruning plants, selective picking, proper storage of beans, and careful processing.  

Roasted to a medium profile, this honey sun-dried lot brews clean, balanced cups. It opens with brown sugar and melon, giving way to roasted almonds, prunes, and a whisper of brown spice. The body is round and syrupy; the finish is long and zesty.  

We recommend brewing it as an espresso, or using a French Press or Channi. It tastes great black as well as with milk.

Recommended Resting Period: 11 Days

Note: This coffee pack has limited availability and therefore cannot be included in a subscription plan.

products.title: Cold Brew Bags - Light Blend
products.body_html:
Fruity + Refreshing

If you enjoy a fruity flavour profile, this one’s for you. Our Cold Brew Light is a refreshing blend that shines with fruity notes of berry and subtle hints of white chocolate, best consumed black. 

Each box contains Cold Brew sachets of 50g each.

products.title: The Mocha Mix
products.body_html:
This duo brings together two distinct takes on a café mocha in a simple, mix-and-drink form. It includes: -  

  • Sea Salt Mocha: A little indulgence to drop into your days, with notes of salted caramel, milk chocolate, and candy.
  • Chilli Cinnamon Mocha: Spicy and bold with deep cocoa notes, balanced by a hit of chilli, and a lush, date-like sweetness.

products.title: The Sunrise Combo
products.body_html:
Enjoy starting your day with a comforting, milk-based brew? This pairing brings together two of our favourite recipes in a simple, mix-and-drink form. It includes: -  

  • Signature: Reminiscent of the lattes we serve in our cafes, this Drop brews cups with notes of caramel, grapes, and chocolate.
  • Jaggery: This Drop reminds us of a rich cup of South Indian filter coffee, and brews cups with notes of toffee, dark chocolate, and vanilla.

products.title: Coffee Cascara
products.body_html:
This delicious cold brew was made using a little known byproduct of coffee processing - Cascara, the dried skin of coffee cherries. With its tea-like flavours, this unique option is perfect for people looking for something fruity and light bodied. 

All our cold brews use 100% Arabica, are sourced directly from India’s best farms and are roasted with precision for a unique flavour.

Ingredients: Filtered water, Arabica coffee cherry
Nutritional Values (per 100ml): Energy 9 cal, Carbs 0.9g, Natural Sugar 0.9g, Protein 0.5g, Total Fat 0.4g

Each can is 250ml.

This product contains no added sugars.

You can purchase this as a pack of 2 or 6. Save 12% when you purchase a pack of 6!

products.title: The Teenage Trail - Box of 13 Coffees
products.body_html:
This limited-release marks our first teen year, bringing together thirteen of our most-loved brews from across regions, roast levels, and flavour profiles. And if you've been meaning to give your coffee routine a stir, this is a great place to start. You'll revisit cups that you have returned to over the years while finding new favourites along the way.

The selection includes 30g tasting jars of:

Garigekhan Estate

A bright, layered cup showcasing Castillo, a resilient Arabica variety created specifically to combat leaf rust.

Roast Level: Light | Processing: Washed| Tasting Notes: Grapefruit, Pomegranate, Cherry

Riverdale Estate – Aroma

A layered, fruit-forward cup, bright with the aroma of berries and pineapple.

Roast Level: Light | Processing: Natural | Tasting Notes: Floral, Candy, Berries

Seethargundu Estate

A delicate and complex coffee from a Demeter-certified estate that treats their land as a living ecosystem, nurturing soil health, biodiversity, and long-term balance.

Roast Level: Light | Processing: Washed | Tasting Notes: Sweet Lime, Black Tea, Stone Fruit

Baarbara Estate – Intenso Yeast

An experimental lot processed with intenso yeast, a yeast usually used by beer brewers.

Roast Level: Light | Processing: Natural | Tasting Notes: Strawberry, Red Currant, Rose

13th Birthday Blend

A limited-edition reminiscent of the Black Forest cakes many of us celebrated teen birthdays with.

Roast Level: Medium | Processing: Washed + Natural | Tasting Notes: Cherry, Chocolate, Strawberry, Pear

Silver Oak Blend

Our signature blend that brings a little of our cafe experience to you.

Roast Level: Medium | Processing: Washed + Natural | Tasting Notes: Hazelnut, Honey, Grapes

Amruthavarshini Estate

A fruity and nutty coffee, sourced from a women-led estate.

Roast Level: Medium | Processing: Natural | Tasting Notes: Cherries, Pineapples, Roasted Almonds

MSP Orchardale Estate

A fruity and punchy coffee from the misty high peaks of Yercaud.

Roast Level: Medium | Processing: Natural | Tasting Notes: Caramel, Cherry, Chocolate

Attikan Estate

A favourite among homebrewers with nutty overtones and balanced acidity.

Roast Level: Medium-Dark | Processing: Washed | Tasting Notes: Dark Chocolate, Figs, Roaster Almonds

St. Joseph’s Estate

Our first release from a partner farm run by Jesuit priests in the Palani Hills, Tamil Nadu.

Roast Level: Medium-Dark | Processing: Washed | Tasting Notes: Grapefruit, Clove, Toffee

Monsoon Malabar

A timeless delight, as rich in flavour as history.

Roast Level: Medium-Dark | Processing: Monsooned | Tasting Notes: Cocoa Nibs, Nutty, Raisins

Vienna Roast

Our most-loved dark roast, perfect for those who enjoy a bold cup.

Roast Level: Dark | Processing: Washed | Tasting Notes: Cocoa, Oaky, Bittersweet

Dhak Blend

An ode to one of our favourite flowers with colourful flame-like flowers that signal the onset of Spring.

Roast Level: Dark | Processing: Natural | Tasting Notes: Dark Chocolate, Cocoa, Fruit Jam

Note: This coffee pack is a special release with limited availability and, therefore, cannot be included in a subscription plan.

products.title: Everyday Essentials Matcha Kit
products.body_html:
This beginner-friendly kit presents a fuss-free way to start a matcha routine. 

Created by our friends at Got Tea, it pairs ceremonial-grade matcha with the two tools that matter most for daily preparation, a bamboo scoop and a matcha whisk.  

The kit includes:  

  • Ceremonial-grade matcha powder (60 g)
  • Chashaku (bamboo scoop) for precise measuring 
  • Chasen (matcha whisk) to achieve a smooth, even texture

products.title: Full Experience Matcha Kit
products.body_html:
This kit brings together everything you need to prepare matcha the traditional way. Created by our friends at Got Tea, it is designed to help you learn the craft or refine an existing ritual. 

Inside, you will find ceremonial-grade matcha paired with the essential tools for a balanced, well-textured cup. A clear, step-by-step manual guides you through each stage, helping you understand not just how to prepare matcha, but why each step matters. 

The kit includes: 

  • Ceremonial-grade matcha powder (60 g)
  • Chawan (matcha bowl) for comfortable whisking
  • Chasen (matcha whisk) to achieve a smooth, even texture
  • Naoshi (whisk stand) to help retain the whisk’s shape
  • Chashaku (bamboo scoop) for precise measuring
  • Sieve to remove clumps before whisking

products.title: Iced latte Cans
products.body_html:

How it’s brewed: Milk and sugar are added to barista brewed espresso shots to make this refreshing iced latte.

products.title: Jaggery | Drop - Specialty Coffee Concentrate
products.body_html: This Drop reminds us of a rich cup of South Indian filter coffee, and is just what we imagine comfort in a cup to be like. With notes of toffee, dark chocolate, and vanilla, it tastes great black, and also pairs well with milk.

products.title: Chilli Cinnamon Mocha | Drop - Specialty Coffee Concentrate
products.body_html:
Inspired by one of our most-loved cafe drinks, This Drop balances deep cocoa notes with a hit of chilli and a lush, date-like sweetness. With minimal bitterness, it is perfect for days that call for a little bit of spunk.  

We love it with ice and milk. But, feel free to make it your own with any twist you like.

products.body_html:
This Drop is how we slip a little indulgence into our days. Its sweetness is perfectly balanced by the sea salt, letting notes of salted caramel, milk chocolate, and candy shine.  

We are always tempted to pour it over ice cream for a quick affogato.

products.title: Signature | Drop - Specialty Coffee Concentrate
products.body_html:

Feel free to make it your own with any twist you like.

products.title: Americano | Drop - Specialty Coffee Concentrate

We love it as is but feel free to make it your own with any twist you like.
